verified_claims.claim: 深海冷泉分离株 OUCF108 通过 ITS (99.86%) 鉴定为 Penicillium javanicum；基因组 antiSMASH 注释识别 59 个候选 BGC，其中 32 个属 PKS。
verified_claims.evidence: 原文摘录: 'identified as P. javanicum on the basis of its internal transcribed spacer (ITS) sequence (99.86% identity with the type strain). Whole-genome sequencing followed by bioinformatic analysis using antiSMASH detected 59 putative BGCs, of which 32 were classified as polyketide synthase (PKS) gene clusters.'

verified_claims.claim: pig1 (Cluster 2.2, 48.3 kb) 与 pig2 (Cluster 39.1, 49.1 kb)；核心 NR-PKS PigA1/PigA2 氨基酸序列一致性 67%。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 3 页 Figure 1A 附近 + 第 3-4 页 SSN 分析段
verified_claims.evidence: 原文摘录: 'two highly homologous PKS loci attracted our attention: pig1 (Cluster 2.2, 48.3 kb) and pig2 (Cluster 39.1, 49.1 kb, Figure 1A)... PigA1 (from pig1) and PigA2 (from pig2), which share 67% amino acid sequence identity.'

verified_claims.claim: pig2 核心基因 (pigA2/pigN2/pigF2) FPKM > 600；pig1 对应同源基因 (pigA1/pigH1/pigO1) FPKM < 10，表明 pig1 转录沉默。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 4 页 2.2 节 + Figure 2A
verified_claims.evidence: 原文摘录: 'the core genes of pig2, including pigA2 (NR-PKS), pigN2 (O-methyltransferase), and pigF2 (laccase), were expressed at high levels (FPKM > 600), whereas the corresponding orthologs in pig1 (pigA1, pigH1, pigO1) expressed at very low levels (FPKM < 10) across all conditions tested.'

verified_claims.claim: Δku70ΔpigA2 突变株彻底丧失 (R)-semivioxanthin (1) 产生，且无 pig1 补偿产物；pig2 被确立为必需的萘并吡喃酮 BGC。
verified_claims.evidence: 原文摘录: 'HPLC analysis of the ∆pigA2 mutant culture extracts showed complete abolishment of (R)-semivioxanthin (1) production, whereas the wild-type strain accumulated 1 as the dominant metabolite (Figure 2B). No compensatory production of naphthopyranones was observed in the ∆pigA2 mutant... these results established that under the tested conditions, pig2 is the essential BGC responsible for naphthopyranone biosynthesis.'

verified_claims.claim: 新化合物 nor-4-hydroxy-toralactone (4) 对耳念珠菌 C. auris MIC = 12.5 µg mL⁻¹；绝对构型 3R,4R；4 与 2 仅差 C-4 羟基，提示 C-4 羟基为关键药效团。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 摘要 + 第 7-9 页 + Conclusions
verified_claims.evidence: 原文摘录 (摘要): 'the new naphthopyranone derivative, nor-4-hydroxy-toralactone (4)... exhibits moderate antifungal activity against the multidrug-resistant pathogen Candida auris (MIC = 12.5 µg mL⁻¹). Structure–activity relationship analysis identified the C-4 hydroxyl moiety is critical for activity.' 又 (第 7 页): 'the absolute configuration of 4 was assigned as 3R, 4R.'

verified_claims.claim: PigN2 催化区域选择性 6-O-甲基化 (nor-toralactone 2 → toralactone 5)，且对 nor-rubrofusarin 完全转化、emodin 部分转化、DHN 无活性，显示底物谱偏向多环芳香骨架。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 8 页 2.5 节 + Figure 5A
verified_claims.evidence: 原文摘录: 'Incubation of PigN2 with nor-toralactone (2) and SAM afforded a single product identified as toralactone (5) by HPLC and HR-ESI-MS, confirming regioselective 6-O-methylation... PigN2 completely converted the structural analog nor-rubrofusarin to rubrofusarin and partially transformed emodin to physcion. In contrast, no catalytic activity was observed toward DHN.'

verified_claims.claim: PigF2 单独催化 (R)-semivioxanthin (1) 的 5,5'-偶联生成 pigmentosin A (6)；PigG2 改变偶联区域化学，额外产生区域异构二聚体 7/8 与氢化副产物 9/10 (C30H24O10, [M+H]+ m/z 549.1755)。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 5-6 页 + 第 7-9 页 + Figure 3B + Figure 5B
verified_claims.evidence: 原文摘录 (第 5-6 页): 'The transformant AO-pigA2H2N2F2 accumulated new peaks... consistent with homodimeric naphthopyrones... indicating that PigF2 catalyzes the oxidative dimerization... The resulting transformant AO-pigA2H2N2F2G2 produced a distinct set of dimeric peaks... two additional minor peaks, 9 and 10... 9 and 10 possess a molecular weight of 548, suggesting they are hydrogenated products.' 又 (第 9 页): 'Co-expression of PigG2 with PigF2, either in vivo (AO-pigA2H2N2F2G2) or in the cell-free lysate system, altered the regiochemical outcome, affording the additional regioisomeric dimers 7 and 8 alongside 6.'

verified_claims.claim: pig1 单独表达 pigA1 (AO-pigA1) 仍产生 nor-toralactone (2)，但 pig1 下游修饰酶共表达均无新产物 → pig1 被判定为保留骨架活性、丧失下游修饰功能的进化假基因簇。
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 第 6 页 2.3 节 + Figure 3A
verified_claims.evidence: 原文摘录: 'Introduction of the pig1 core PKS gene pigA1 alone into A. oryzae NSAR1 (AO-pigA1) afforded 2 as the product, identical to that generated by pigA2 (Figure 3A, panel i)... However, when we co-expressed pigA1 with the remaining pig1 tailoring genes, no new metabolite peaks were detected beyond 2 (Figure 3A, panels ii~vii). These results indicated that although the pig1 PKS gene pigA1 encodes a functional backbone generating enzyme, the downstream tailoring genes within pig1 are non-functional in the heterologous host.'
